scope: Sourced late context for World Cup 2026 remaining knockout predictions as of the semi-final window.

applicationPolicy.numericUse: Only explicit fixture/team expected-goals multipliers are applied. All other sourced notes are explanatory context.
applicationPolicy.lineupPolicy: Do not invent lineups. Expected availability is not treated as confirmed until official lineups exist.
applicationPolicy.weatherPolicy: Weather is applied only when a reliable source indicates likely on-field conditions; roofed or climate-controlled venues are neutral unless disruption is specifically expected.

globalFactors.summary: Yellow-card accumulation is reported as reset after the quarter-finals, reducing semi-final suspension risk from accumulated yellows.
globalFactors.modelEffect: No yellow-card accumulation suspension penalty applied for semi-final predictions.

fixtureContexts.summary: France have the longer rest window after a 90-minute quarter-final; Spain are reported fully fit, while France's Mbappe and Kone concerns are described as minor. Controlled AT&T Stadium conditions keep weather neutral.

teamAdjustments.rationale: Small rest advantage over Spain after both quarter-finals ended in 90 minutes; minor availability concerns are not strong enough for a separate penalty.
Slightly shorter recovery window than France; fully fit squad note keeps the adjustment very small.

contextOnlyFactors: France and Spain are reported as unbeaten and not having trailed in the tournament.
France's Mbappe and Kone concerns are reported as minor; Spain are reported fully fit.
AT&T Stadium conditions are treated as controlled/neutral for on-field weather impact.

fixtureContexts.summary: England's Rice, Bellingham and James are reported fit or expected to be available, but Rice illness/managed fitness and Argentina's slightly shorter recovery after extra time keep both teams close to neutral. Atlanta roof/climate control keeps weather neutral for on-field play.

teamAdjustments.rationale: Availability news is mostly positive, but Rice's recent illness/managed condition keeps a tiny caution discount.
Argentina played 120 minutes and have a slightly shorter recovery window than England; no confirmed player absence is applied.

contextOnlyFactors: Declan Rice is reported likely to start after illness.
Jude Bellingham is reported fit despite shoulder attention.
Reece James is reported fit and ready.
Atlanta Stadium conditions are treated as climate-controlled and weather-neutral for on-field play.

warnings: No official starting lineups were available at collection time.
No trusted xG, shot, event, player-minute, or complete card-log source was added.
News-source availability notes are treated conservatively and do not override official results or team-strength inputs.
